claims.question: Q1
claims.answer: The semantically correct status is 422; RFC 9110 renamed it from Unprocessable Entity to Unprocessable Content.

claims.question: Q2
claims.answer: Retry-After is permitted but not required, and it is defined for 503, 429 and 3xx rather than being tied to one of them.

claims.question: Q3
claims.answer: There is no such field. It appears in neither RFC 9110 nor the IANA HTTP field name registry, so nothing standardises it and any implementation using it has invented it.

gaps: Whether any widely deployed proxy emits the header as a vendor extension was not checked.
